scope: Adaptive full-state continuation after the early screen, frozen before long training.
optimizer: Schedule-Free AdamW only; preserve source lr, decay, betas, epsilon and warmup
state: query, base, second moment, averaging clock and next sampler state retained
questions: Does unchanged training cross99% after the2000-update plateau?
Does the deeper source model close its early division gap with more updates?
Can the mixed flat-character task generalize despite its completion obstruction?
Does incomplete full-table fitting resolve with more updates?
Can the short chain learn its local update or extrapolate to double length?
report: All endpoints, curves, epochs, source/replay hashes, transitions and relapses; timeout and not-started are unfinished.
limits: One initialization per long case; no universal convergence or impossibility result.
The current recipe differs from diff_gpt test_div97 (lr.01, decay1, batch512, W128D1, padded vocabulary and replacement sampling).
No residual architecture change during a continuation. Residual tests are a separate diagnostic/cohort.
